description.value: Oak & Sparrow Estate Winery is a family-owned small-batch winery perched on the Golden Mile slopes of the Okanagan Valley near Oliver, BC — one of the most celebrated cycling wine routes in Canada. The estate produces wines including Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and Rosé from its own vineyard, and recently completed a tasting room and large patio with vineyard views where tastings can be booked in advance or taken as walk-ins.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name, address (4929 BC-97, Oliver, BC V0H 1T1), and phone (250) 408-5130. The site describes a tasting room with a large patio overlooking the vineyard and an online wine shop, confirming it is an active, open estate winery. No website content mentions bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so all such fields are null.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone — both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
OSM name 'Oak & Sparrow' is shortened; website uses 'Oak & Sparrow Estate Winery' throughout. Minor discrepancy, not a mismatch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The winery is a legitimate, active business on the popular Golden Mile cycling corridor and would be a natural stop for touring cyclists, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify these before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: Located on BC-97 (the Golden Mile Wine Route) in Oliver — a very common cycling destination. Confirming basic cyclist amenities (bike parking, washroom access, water) via phone or site visit would likely qualify this for inclusion.
